title: AW27 Women's Soft Armour
summary: Coats and suits that look classic and perform like outdoor wear: hidden membranes, bi-stretch, double-faced wool and light volume.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Performance is now hidden inside the material: waterproof, breathable or windproof membranes and bi-stretch in citywear suitings <sup>[1]</sup>. Double-faced wool returns in more weights and wool becomes lighter and softer <sup>[1]</sup>. FashionUnited's "Urban Retreater" wants a coat that performs on the commute and looks like tailoring at dinner <sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Greyed blue, mushroom and tinted black.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Broad-shoulder double-faced coat.
- Technical blazer and tapered trouser.
- Light quilted liners.

sections.heading: Fabrics
sections.body: Double-faced wool and cashmere, membrane-backed suiting, bi-stretch twill.

sections.heading: Trims and details
sections.body: Concealed zips, magnetic closures, bonded seams.

design_implications: - Bonded seams to keep the tailored look.
commercial_implications: - Coats at premium; technical suits as a commuter capsule.
